text:
WOW!!! LOOK AT THAT BIG GREEN TRACTOR!!! 🚜💚 It’s SO COOL!!! The man is wearing a super bright yellow jacket and ORANGE pants like a fireman! And he has big red earmuffs on his ears—maybe so the tractor doesn’t go “VROOM VROOM” too loud?! 😂

He’s sitting up HIGH in the driver’s seat, holding the steering wheel like he’s racing to win first place! The wheels are HUGE with black tires and yellow centers—they look like giant donuts! 🍩🚗

And guess what?? There’s something BLUE attached to the back—it looks like a magic arm or maybe a scoop for digging stuff!! Is it gonna pick up cars? Or make mountains of dirt?! I wanna ride on it!!! 🤘

The sky is blue, there are trees behind the fence, and even a little house peeking out—but ALL I care about is that AWESOME TRACTOR!!! Can we go see one in real life please?? Pleeease?? I’ll share my cookies if you say yes!! 🍪

#TractorLove #BigGreenMachine #FutureFarmer
